description: Generate and edit music with hosted ACE-Step 1.5 on Runware.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit music with ACE-Step 1.5.
interface.longDescription: GPTAudioMCP 0.9.0 uses hosted ACE-Step 1.5 on Runware for music generation and reference-audio editing. XL Turbo is the default; XL Base is available for higher-quality, slower edits. The Site manages the Runware key, so no personal provider connection is required.
defaultPrompt: Generate music from our current conversation.
Use the audio file I attached and our conversation as the creative direction.
